ICN.description: Ingest Connector - Configuration and lifecycle of one ingest source.

KIND.description: Transport or source shape used by this connector.

STATUS.description: Connector lifecycle state, independent of any `$STF` listing status.

STATUS_MESSAGE.description: Human-readable detail about the current status.

ENDPOINT_URL.description: HTTPS endpoint from which records are pulled.

HTTP_METHOD.description: HTTP method used for an endpoint request.

AUTH_KIND.description: Authentication shape used for an endpoint request.

AUTH_HEADER_NAME.description: Header name used when AUTH_KIND is ApiKeyHeader.

CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE.description:
Credential-store key resolved only at execution time. A secret never
appears in an ICN record.

POLL_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval in milliseconds between endpoint polls.

DIRECTORY_PATH.description: Directory scanned by a filesystem-watch connector.

SCAN_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval in milliseconds between directory scans.

SETTLE_DELAY_MS.description: Minimum unchanged time in milliseconds before a file is ingested.

POST_INGEST_ACTION.description: Disposition of a source file after verified ingest.

UPLOAD_SESSION_ID.description: Identifier of the bounded upload session.

UPLOAD_FILE_COUNT.description: Number of files accepted into the upload session.

UPLOAD_TOTAL_BYTES.description: Total uploaded byte count across all session files.

UPLOAD_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash covering the uploaded session payload.

DETECTED_FORMAT.description: Detected source serialization or container format.

SAMPLE_RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of records detected in the validation sample.

LAST_INGEST_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last successful ingest.

LAST_ERROR_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last ingest error.

LAST_ERROR.description: Human-readable detail about the last ingest error.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this connector was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this connector was last updated.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the provider that issued this connector record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the connector record.
